facts.title: pickled carrot sticks
ingredients: 1 pound (455 grams) carrots, trimmed, peeled or scrubbed, and cut into 3 1/2- by 1/3-inch sticks
1 cup (235 ml) cider vinegar or plain vinegar (the former makes a sweeter, milder brine)
1 1/2 tablespoons dill seeds, coriander seeds, or black peppercorns, or a mix thereof
facts.cook_time: 15 minutes prep, plus 1 day or more to pickle
facts.author: Deb Perelman
